capabilities.observed_jtbd: Turn a sourcing need into product selections, supplier matches and business research.
capabilities.authority_boundary: The request is a research input, never a Product, Supplier, Quote or business Fact.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Discover products and market opportunities from current research signals.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Exact identity Evidence is required; estimated demand remains observation or inference.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Find and compare supplier options matching exact specifications.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Public supplier observations do not become accepted Supplier Offers.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Analyze hot-selling products, price bands and market trends.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Real Ozon demand evidence is still absent; no sales estimate is promoted to account Fact.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Draft inquiries and move sourcing research toward supplier quotation.
capabilities.authority_boundary: KJDS may draft an immutable RFQ, but supplier contact requires governed dispatch proof and independent review; Agent automatic contact is disabled.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Compare supplier terms and cost implications for a sourcing decision.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Three independently accepted quotes and fifteen evidence-backed downside CM3 components are required; screening is not Actual Cash CM3.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Generate product concepts from consumer and market insight.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Generated concepts remain candidates; Product identity, rights, Passport and media QA are separate authorities.

capabilities.observed_jtbd: Coordinate planning, research and final inquiries in one agent workflow.
capabilities.authority_boundary: Current BAS-145 Agent artifact is decision support only; no self-approval, Permit, supplier contact, purchase or payment.
